title: 并非所有令牌都等价：面向智能体LLM系统的通胀感知路由
summary: 本文提出InflationAgent，一种四阶段路由器，通过量化令牌膨胀（真实工作流成本与单次调用成本之比）来优化模型选择。引入CoT分支熵（CBE）作为预执行难度信号，并采用语义汇率（SER）和新鲜升级策略，在GSM8K上以更少令牌实现更高准确率。
summary_en: This paper proposes InflationAgent, a four-stage router that quantifies token inflation (ratio of true workflow cost to single-call cost) to optimize model selection. It introduces CoT Branching Entropy (CBE) as a pre-execution difficulty signal and uses Semantic Exchange Rate (SER) with fresh-escalation policy, achieving higher accuracy with fewer tokens on GSM8K.
